author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Holliday (groin) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Jackson Holliday remains out of the Orioles lineup on Wednesday against the Angels.
impact: Holliday remains day-to-day with a groin injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roman Anthony (wrist/hand) has not made substantive progress
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Roman Anthony has not made any substantive progress while the team has been away.
impact: Anthony has occasionally tries to swing a lighter bat but hasn't gotten to a real bat/hitting progression. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: JR Ritchie sent back to minors
desc: JR Ritchie was optioned back to Triple-A Gwinnett on Wednesday.
impact: Ritchie allowed five runs (four earned) over five innings in a start against the Padres on Tuesday, striking out seven while walking four. The rookie right-hander will now head back to Triple-A in order for the Braves to activate veteran reliever Tyler Kinley (elbow) from the IL. Ritchie should return to the bigs at some point down the road this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Tyler Kinley (elbow) returns from IL on Wednesday
desc: Tyler Kinley (elbow) will return from the IL ahead of Wednesday's game against the Padres.
impact: Kinley has been on the shelf for just over two weeks due to an elbow issue. The veteran righty has had a nice season to this point for the Braves, posting a 3.18 ERA and 1.20 WHIP with 31 strikeouts across 28 1/3 innings.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tanner McDougal (forearm) continuing to throw, build-up
desc: Tanner McDougal is continuing to throw and build up.
impact: McDougal resumed throwing at the start of June. He is hopeful to get cleared for a rehab assignment soon.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ian Hamilton recalled by Braves
desc: Ian Hamilton was recalled by the Braves ahead of Wednesday's game against the Padres.
impact: Hamilton will join the Braves' bullpen for the second time this season, as he made one appearance back in April. The righty has spent the majority of the season at Triple-A, posting a respectable 3.18 ERA and 28-6 K/BB ratio across 22 2/3 innings. Carlos Carrasco was designated for assignment in a corresponding move.

author: Nate Miller
title: Carlos Carrasco designated for assignment
desc: Carlos Carrasco was designated for assignment by the Braves on Wednesday.
impact: Carrasco has now been designated by the Braves five different times in the last two months, and six times dating back to this past August. If the cycle continues, the  39-year-old righty will clear waivers yet again and rejoin the Braves on a minor-league deal in a couple of days. Ian Hamilton has been recalled from Triple-A Gwinnett in a corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seth Halvorsen recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Rockies recalled Seth Halvorsen from Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Halvorsen will hold a middle-relief role in the Rockies bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jaden Hill (shoulder) placed on IL
desc: The Rockies placed Jaden Hill on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder tendinitis.
impact: Hill had recorded saves in two of his last three appearances. He'll likely be sidelined for at least the next few weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Masyn Winn (thumb) waiting on imaging results
desc: Masyn Winn is awaiting the results of imaging taken of his injured left thumb.
impact: Winn was scratched from Tuesday's lineup. There will be an update on his status when the results are received.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Hollowell recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs recalled Gavin Hollowell from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Hollowell returns to the majors in a middle-relief role with Ben Brown placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Brown (neck) placed on IL
desc: The Cubs placed Ben Brown on the 15-day injured list with a neck strain.
impact: It is unclear if Brown suffered the injury in his last start. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carson Palmquist recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Nationals recalled Carson Palmquist from Triple-A.
impact: Palmquist is set to open Wednesday's game against the Phillies.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jung Hoo Lee goes deep, swipes base in win over Athletics
desc: Jung Hoo Lee went 2-for-3 in Tuesday's 3-1 win over the Athletics with a home run, a walk, one run scored, one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Lee continues a productive stretch at the plate, recording hits in 15 of his last 19 contests. The outfielder has rewarded manager Tony Vitello with one of the more impactful options in the Giants lineup, slashing .331 with five homers, 27 RBI, 40 runs scored, and five steals through 70 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Robbie Ray escapes trouble in win over Athletics
desc: Robbie Ray allowed no earned runs on two hits and four walks while striking out six over eight innings in Tuesday's win over the Athletics.
impact: Ray has settled down on the mound of late, allowing one earned run or less in four of his last five trips to the mound. The left-hander has been more reliable after fighting command issues early in the season for manager Tony Vitello, carrying a 3.70 ERA and 1.28 WHIP with a 6-6 record and 1.9 K/BB ratio across 16 starts.
